text:
oliver.docs: Quick heads-up: while updating Optimize Toolkit -> Batching after the Console navigation change I found two breaking issues in the published examples. Opened a PR with fixes: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/498 — can eng/infra take a look at the Go SDK snippet and the batching window example?
tanya.eng: on it. what specifically is breaking?
oliver.docs: 1) Go snippet shows `BatchWindowMs: 20` (int) but the runtime validator expects a string with units, e.g. "20ms" or the canonical field `batch_window`. 2) JS example used `kv_prefetch` (snake) which our JS SDK maps to `kvPrefetch` — docs should show idiomatic JS casing. Small mismatch but results in 400s in QA.
ben.infra: confirmed from staging logs: `{"error":"invalid_config_field","field":"batch_window","message":"expected string with units, got number"}` — use that exact JSON in the troubleshooting note.
lina.ml: also want a short guidance sentence about prefetched KV sizes: "KV prefetch helps token cache hit-rate for short-turn chat but can increase memory on very wide KV tables; consider toggling per-route." Suggest adding a one-line perf tradeoff under the snippet.
oliver.docs: thanks — I added that sentence and replaced the Go snippet. New examples below, please sanity-check before I merge.
```go
// Go SDK minimal: batching window as duration string
client := redwood.NewClient(os.Getenv("REDWOOD_API_KEY"))
cfg := redwood.Config{
  Batching: true,
  BatchWindow: "20ms", // must be string with units
  KVPrefetch: true,
  QuantProfile: "q4_0_fast_v2",
}
resp, _ := client.Generate(ctx, "Summarize the following text...", cfg)
fmt.Println(resp.Text)
```
```js
// JS SDK example (camelCase keys)
import Redwood from '@redwood/inference'
const client = new Redwood({ apiKey: process.env.REDWOOD_API_KEY })
const config = {
  batching: true,
  batchWindow: '20ms',
  kvPrefetch: true,
  quantProfile: 'q4_0_fast_v2'
}
const resp = await client.generate('Summarize the following text...', config)
console.log(resp.text)
```
tanya.eng: LGTM. small nit: Go field `KVPrefetch` is exported; docs should also show the import path `github.com/redwood-inference/sdk/go/redwood` to help users.
oliver.docs: added import path and a one-line comment about memory tradeoff per Lina. Pushed commit.
ben.infra: one more infra note: anchor names changed during the TOC refactor. Broken links on Optimize -> Batching are `#sdk-params-go` and `#sdk-params-javascript` now (was `#sdk-go-params` and `#sdk-js-params`). I fixed the two links in the PR.
deploy-bot: :white_check_mark: preview build succeeded for PR 498 14 https://deploy-preview-498--docs.redwood.ai/optimize/batching (expires in 48h)
lina.ml: re: quant sentence: prefer wording "q4_0_fast_v2 reduces hallucination on long contexts; legacy q4_0_fast is slightly faster but less stable" — I'll +1 that copy.
oliver.docs: added Lina's copy and the staging error snippet. Requesting quick review from @tanya.eng and @lina.ml. Hoping to merge today so the CLI migration guide can point to stable OptKit examples. :thumbsup:
tanya.eng: reviewing now, will reply within 30m.
lina.ml: approved the quant wording. :ok_hand:
oliver.docs: merged after minor typo fix. Closing the loop, thanks everyone!
